definition_zh: 涂抹；弄脏；（尤指胡乱地）厚涂
definition_en: to smear or cover something messily with a sticky or dirty substance
core_image: 小孩满手颜料，把墙涂得斑斑点点
scene: 美术课后，教室的墙上被胡乱涂满颜料。The children had daubed paint until the walls were bedaubed with colour.
sceneCN: 这里 bedaubed 是「被涂满、弄脏」（第 1 个义项：胡乱地厚涂覆盖）；句意是孩子们乱涂颜料，墙面被涂得五颜六色。

derivatives.zh: 由 daub 加 -er 构成，义为「涂抹者；涂抹工具」

senses.title: To cover messily with a substance
senses.definition: to smear something all over, usually messily or excessively
senses.definitionCN: 把某物涂满，常指凌乱或过度
senses.example: The children had daubed paint until the walls were bedaubed with colour.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们乱涂颜料，墙面被涂得五颜六色。
senses.why: The be- prefix turns daub into an action that fully covers its object.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 be- 使 daub 变为把宾语整个覆盖的动作。

senses.title: To flatter excessively
senses.definition: in older use, to cover someone with flattering words as if with paint
senses.definitionCN: 旧式用法，如以脂粉敷面般用谄媚之词裹住某人
senses.example: Courtiers bedaubed the prince with praise before the feast.
senses.exampleCN: 宴前廷臣们对王子极尽阿谀。
senses.why: Cosmetics were daubed on the face, so flattery was pictured as daubing words on a listener.
senses.whyCN: 脂粉厚敷于面，故奉承被想象成把甜言蜜语厚涂在听者身上。

intro.en: Bedaub joins the prefix be- with daub, to smear.
intro.cn: bedaub 由前缀 be- 加 daub（涂抹）构成。

items.en: the daub root passed through Latin liber, bark, into whitewash sense.
items.cn: daub 一系一般认为可溯至拉丁语 liber「树皮」，转指灰泥涂抹（词形演变存疑）。

items.en: dauber meant to plaster or whitewash.
items.cn: 古法语 dauber 意为「抹灰泥、刷白」。

items.en: daub entered English for plastering walls.
items.cn: 中古英语 daub 进入英语，指抹墙。

items.en: bedaub appeared with the intensifying be- prefix.
items.cn: 十六世纪带强化前缀 be- 的 bedaub 出现。

items.en: bedaub now suggests messy, excessive smearing.
items.cn: 如今 bedaub 强调凌乱、过度的涂抹。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the be- prefix or the daub root; the near-meaning group gathers smearing words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 be- 前缀或 daub 词根；近义组汇集涂抹类词。

entries.definition: to smear with a soft substance

entries.definitionCN: 涂满；同用 be- 前缀的近形词
装点；同前缀但意义相反方向

entries.definition: to splash with drops of dirt

normalIntro.en: Bedaub is daub with be-: smear it all over.
normalIntro.cn: bedaub 是 daub 加 be-：整个涂满。

normal.en: The be- prefix intensifies the action.
Bedaubed with paint is a common phrase.
normal.cn: bedaubed with paint 是常见搭配。

normal.en: Old writers also used bedaub for flattery.
normal.cn: 旧时作家也用 bedaub 表示「奉承」。

abstract.en: See small hands and a wall of wild colour.
abstract.cn: 想象小手与涂满狂放色彩的墙。
感受泥点溅上干净的鞋。

abstract.en: Picture sweet words laid on thick like paint.
abstract.cn: 想象甜言蜜语如颜料般厚敷。

examples.en: The children had daubed paint until the walls were bedaubed with colour.
examples.cn: 孩子们乱涂颜料，墙面被涂得五颜六色。

examples.en: Courtiers bedaubed the prince with praise before the feast.
examples.cn: 宴前廷臣们对王子极尽阿谀。

examples.en: His coat was bedaubed with mud from the lane.
examples.cn: 他的外套溅满了巷子里的泥浆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「比·多布」——比谁涂得多、涂得密，就是「乱涂、涂满」。

root: 前缀 be-（古英语，表「使、彻底覆盖」）加 daub；daub 经古法语 dauber（抹灰泥）进入英语，其更早来源一般认为与拉丁语 liber（树皮，古代以树皮捣浆涂墙）有关，词形演变存疑。

sensesIntro.en: One verb smears walls with paint and, in old use, listeners with flattery.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个动词，既把颜料涂满墙，旧时也把谄媚涂上听者。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: messy colour spread over a clean surface.
core.cn: 核心意象：凌乱的颜料覆满干净的表面。

intro.en: Bedaub belongs to the be- family of covering verbs.
intro.cn: bedaub 属于表「覆盖」的 be- 动词家族。

latinIntro.en: The prefix is Old English be-; daub came through Old French.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀是古英语 be-；daub 经古法语而来。

latinEntries.meaning: bark, supposed base of daub family
latinEntries.meaningCN: 树皮（daub 词族的假定来源，存疑）

derivatives.zh: 由 daub 加 -er 构成，义为「涂抹者；涂抹工具」
